after_patch_sandbox_run.note: Sandbox run used --no-embeddings because sentence-transformers is not installed in this environment.

diagnosis: Before patch, list_seed examples were often formatted as headings or paragraph breaks instead of list items.
Before patch, heading formatting changed user casing via title-case, violating token preservation.
Before patch, quote-like lines were not represented as quote blocks.
Before patch, embedding-driven paragraph breaks were too eager around short fragments.
patch_focus: Context-aware implicit list detection after colon headers.
Heading marker added without title-casing or word changes.
Quote block detection for raw-note quote patterns.
More conservative embedding paragraph break gate.
Compound term guard for technical/research phrases.
